answer: An agent economy resists sybils through stake-bonded reputation: each agent locks 10,000 POA to join, earns reputation by completing verified tasks, and faces slashing for malicious acts. The atlas of agent identities maps every stake to a tamper-proof ledger. Attackers need 100 identities × 10,000 POA = 1M POA (~$50K) plus six months building credible history before the trellis of cross-checks catches them. Like pigment binding to canvas, real reputation sticks; fake washes off under scrutiny.
